verdict.rationale: Poke's docs describe an 'Integrations' feature where users connect apps like Webflow and others to the assistant (poke-docs-7, poke-docs-15), and a separate MCP 'recipes' ecosystem where users can install community-built MCP servers/tools (poke-docs-3, poke-docs-5). This implies a directory-like listing of connectable apps/connectors, but the evidence never explicitly shows a browsable UI or catalog with many entries, only a couple of named integrations. Missing for 10: a full directory/catalog view with breadth of listed apps, independent confirmation of ease-of-browsing, and search/discovery features.
